source: Appendix B-1 URAR Implementation Guide v1.4, section overviews

rules.Subject Property: The Subject Property section always displays.
rules.Site: The Site section always displays in the report; however, there are multiple data points from the Subject Property section that determine conditionality, such as: • Subject Site Owned in Common - LandOwnedInCommonIndicator (UID: 0100.0047, FID: 3.015) • PropertyInProjectIndicator (UID: 0100.0065, FID: Not on report) • Subject Property - ProjectLegalStructureType (UID: 2500.0168) o Condominium (FID: 3.011) o Coop (FID: 3.012) o Condop (FID: 3.013) Site Size and Parcels When Subject Site Owned in Common - LandOwnedInCommonIndicator (UID: 0100.0047, FID: 3.015) = "false" • Total Site Size - LotSizeAreaMeasure (UID: 1500.0093, FID: 4.000) displays Page 125 Appendix B-1: URAR Implementation Guide v1.4 • For area less than 1 acre, use square feet in whole numbers (e.
rules.Disaster Mitigation: The Disaster Mitigation section displays when DisasterMitigationFeatureType (UID: 3700.0002, FID: 5.000) is a value other than ‘None’.
rules.Energy Efficient and Green Features: The Energy Efficient and Green Features section displays when one or more of the three energy efficient or green features is "true".
rules.Dwelling Exterior: The Dwelling Exterior section displays when ImprovementType (UID: 0300.0009, FID: Not on report) = "Dwelling".
rules.Manufactured Home: The Manufactured Home section displays details about the structure, provides space for additional commentary, and exhibits.
rules.Unit Interior: The Unit Interior section always displays.
rules.Functional Obsolescence: The Functional Obsolescence section always displays in the report.
rules.Outbuilding: The Outbuilding section displays when ImprovementType (UID: 0300.0009, FID: Not on report) = "Outbuilding".
rules.Vehicle Storage: The Vehicle Storage section always displays.
rules.Subject Property Amenities: The Subject Property Amenities section always displays in the report.
rules.Overall Quality and Condition: The Overall Quality and Condition section always displays.
rules.Highest and Best Use: The Highest and Best Use section always displays with the static text, "Is the present use of the subject property …", followed by the required fields.
rules.Project Information: The Project Information section displays when the property is in a project (condominium, cooperative, or condop) or in a PUD.
rules.Sales Contract: The Sales Contract section displays when SalesContractExistsIndicator (UID: 0600.0016, FID: 20.000) = "true".
rules.Prior Sale and Transfer History: The Prior Sale and Transfer History section always displays in the report.
rules.Rental Information: The Rental Information section displays when RentScheduleIndicator (UID: 1000.0031, FID: Not on report) = "true".
rules.Cost Approach: The Cost Approach section displays when CostApproachIndicator (UID: 1000.0027, FID: Not on report) = "true".
rules.Revision History: The Revision History section displays only if the information is provided.
